items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Louis at the Met. No, at the Vendome Theater. ... Louis was a member of Erskine Tate's band, playing in the pit.

ctx.x: Was he as powerful as Louie Armstrong, or --
He's more powerful than Louie, yeah, he was more powerful than anybody I ever knew.
Yeah? Well, Bechet was pretty powerful, too.
